profile.headline: Embedded stuff
profile.summary:
I help build interesting things like the Sonic Sphere.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: - Creative software and electrical design on a volunteer basis

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: - Powertrain and HVAC thermal systems (Model S/X/3)

positions.title: Software Design Engineering
positions.description:
-   Design and development of new HTML5/jQueryMobile hybrid app on iOS and Android
-   Port native mobile app implementation for live/VOD video and audio streaming
-   Experience with PHP Zend Framework for web service implementations

positions.title: Firmware Intern - Gateway Developer
positions.description:
-   Implementation of Diagnostic Trouble Code framework for the Gateway ECU
-   Autonomous drive module for monitoring ECU health
-   Experience with CAN protocol and embedded firmware
-   Worked on development infrastructure with SCons

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-  Built an embedded Linux driver for FPGA remote debug over Ethernet
-  Optimized remote debug over Verilog simulation with VPI invocation
-  Enable dynamic loading of JVM in process for console tools
-  Experimentation and newfound passion with FPGA hardware

positions.title: QA Automation Specialist
positions.description:
-   Design of end-to-end automation testing framework for QA team
-   Automatic generation of test cases, execution rules, and validation procedures
-   Usage of industry applications in analysis of output media
-   Research of open-source alternatives for specialized functions
-   XML database design and parsing
-   Immersion in Apache Software Foundation tools

positions.title: Software QA Analyst
positions.description:
-   QA video processing software and hardware testing
-   Verification of live streaming applications, codecs specifications, and hardware output
-   Construction of centralized QA test media repository
-   Experience with latest video codecs: H.264, MPEG-2, WMV, etc.

positions.title: IT/Network Support Analyst
positions.description:
-   Provided user network/IT support services for internal employees
-   Debugged and tested hardware/software for implementation
-   Supported the company in the installation of new computers
